subject: Recap + Next Steps: Redwood demo & procurement handoff
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@greenleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Next Steps: Redwood demo & procurement handoff

Hi Alex

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum:

- What we heard: primary goal is to reduce inference cost on batch reports and improve latency for interactive analyst queries. Key constraints: SOC2 requirement for data isolation and standard vendor onboarding.
- What we proposed: Redwood Dedicated with reserved capacity + automatic prefix caching for the ingestion pipeline.
- Open items for Greenleaf: vendor setup (W-9 + ACH), PO/contract cadence, and portal activation so we can provision capacity.

Next steps:
1) I'll loop in our procurement lead, Marissa Cole, to start vendor onboarding and send the portal invite. (cc'd)
2) If you can share the W-9 and ACH instructions, Marissa will get the vendor record created — expected turnaround ~3-5 business days once docs are in.
3) We'll provision a reserved slot for a short smoke test once the portal shows the vendor as active.

I attached a short mutual action plan to make the steps explicit. Let me know if any of the priorities/timing have changed on your side.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Camila

Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: W-9 & portal invite (Greenleaf Finance)

Hi Alex

Looping you in from procurement. I've submitted the vendor invite from our onboarding portal — you should receive an email from vendors@redwood.com with steps to claim the vendor record. To complete vendor setup we need:

- Completed W-9 (PDF)
- ACH instructions or remittance contact
- Point of contact for invoicing (name + email)

For convenience I attached our vendor onboarding checklist with specific file naming and field guidance. Once the portal shows Greenleaf as active I'll confirm and we'll schedule the short smoke test Camila mentioned.

If you don't see the invite, please check spam or let me know and I can resend.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
